meta.scope: Reconcile S040 card with publisher full text, participant-level LOSOV and group metrics

records.title: GIAFormer: A Gradient-Infused Attention and Transformer for Pain Assessment with EDA-fNIRS Fusion

searches.query: S040 DOI 10.1016/j.inffus.2026.104173 primary full text Sections 3.1/3.4/4.1 Table 3

updates.задача: Three-class acute experimental pain-intensity classification (No Pain, Low Pain, High Pain) from EDA and fNIRS in healthy AI4Pain participants.
updates.метод: GIAFormer fuses EDA and fNIRS using gradient-infused attention and a Transformer. Performance evaluation uses leave-one-subject-out validation: one participant is held out per fold and fold metrics are averaged.
updates.датасет: AI4Pain: 65 healthy participants (42 male, 23 female), aged 17-52; 2,340 non-overlapping 10-second EDA/fNIRS observations, 36 segments per person and 780 per class. These segments are repeated observations, not independent participants.
updates.производительность: Published Table 3, mean +/- SD across leave-one-subject-out folds: accuracy 90.51% +/- 9.33, F1 90.38% +/- 9.65, specificity 95.26% +/- 4.66; class TPRs 94.36% +/- 8.35 (No Pain), 88.97% +/- 15.46 (Low Pain), 88.21% +/- 13.49 (High Pain). These are author-reported, not externally reproduced.
updates.кросс_субъект: Yes: leave-one-subject-out across the 65 AI4Pain participants; each participant is the test set once. No independent external cohort was tested.
updates.ограничения: Full publisher PDF body recovered from embedded page objects in a publisher-served artifact (SHA-256 8474bc90b239dcfcf970338cde2ff62629699e9aa0782e04c89ba661eb16a7dd); the active PDF page tree exposes only page 1. Results concern controlled acute experimental stimuli in 65 healthy people and 2,340 repeated segments. The reported +/- values are across LOSO folds, not prediction intervals or calibration. No independent external cohort or probability calibration is reported. Dataset access is on reasonable request; the cited code repository did not expose the trained code/models in this check. This study does not validate chronic pain, ECAP, SCS treatment response or clinical deployment.

evidence.population: 65 healthy human volunteers (42 male, 23 female), age 17-52, mean age 29.06 +/- 8.28 years; AI4Pain acute controlled stimulation.
evidence.target_label: No Pain (L0), Low Pain (L1, individual QST threshold) and High Pain (L2, individual QST tolerance), based on controlled electrical stimulation; not a common clinical NRS endpoint.

validation.notes: Publisher-served PDF checked 2026-09-27, 7,464,349 bytes, SHA-256 8474bc90b239dcfcf970338cde2ff62629699e9aa0782e04c89ba661eb16a7dd. Its active tree exposes only first page, but all 16 published pages were recovered from embedded page content objects and checked against the owner title/abstract. Section 3.1 reports 65 healthy participants, three QST-defined classes and 2,340 repeated segments; Section 3.4 reports participant-held-out LOSOV; Table 3 reports 90.51% +/- 9.33 accuracy and fold SD. No external cohort or calibration is reported; data are request-only. No chronic-pain, ECAP or SCS outcome conclusion.
